name: Clubdorf Hotel Tirolerhof
beschreibung: The Clubdorf Hotel Tirolerhof is located in the municipality of See in the Tiroler Paznauntal and offers direct access to the surrounding ski areas and hiking trails. The extensive hotel complex is designed around the all-inclusive concept and has several restaurants, bars, and a large wellness area with swimming pools and saunas. A supervised kids' club, a sports program, and evening entertainment events provide entertainment for guests. The facilities are tailored to families with children and active couples who appreciate a well-organized vacation routine. The atmosphere is lively, while quiet zones for adults offer variety. Guests who prefer comprehensive care and catering without additional planning will find suitable conditions here.
